missions.title: Bay of Bengal
missions.description:
Campaign Region 1: "BAY OF BENGAL."

India has mobilized amphibious assault forces and has deployed INS Viraat in the Gulf of Mannar. Your forces are to transit to Southwest coast of Sri Lanka to pressure India to withdraw forces. Sri Lanka fears Indian military buildup in preparation to final invasion force and collapse of the government. The United Nations has requested that a U.S. CVBG be sent to the area to stabilize the region.
missions.intel:
Intelligence Message. The Indian CVBG is operating in the Gulf of Mannar (about 35 NM Northwest of Colombo). Russia has deployed TU-22M Backfire aircraft to India. China has delivered a squadron of B-6 Badger aircraft to India. Indian Submarine activity in 
the region is significant. U. S. Embassy in Sri Lanka is urging all Americans to leave the country. All Indian Naval forces are considered hostile.
missions.task: Tasking Message. Transit to within 35 NM Southwest of the Sri Lanka coast. Repulse Indian Naval forces which attempt to prevent U. S. CVBG forces from completing this mission. U. S. Ambassador may be extracted from Embassy in Sri Lanka if situation worsens. Be alert to neutral air and merchant traffic operating in this area. Additional tasking may be received during this mission.

goals.name: Bay of Bengal
goals.success: You have completed all the required Tasks in Region 1 Bay of Bengal.
goals.failure: Nice Try, but you have not mastered region one Bay of Bengal. Try again, when you are up to the task. Good Luck.

missions.title: Strait of Malacca
missions.description:
Campaign Region 2: "Strait of Malacca." China's People's Liberation Army (PLA) forces have conducted a massive incursion into Burma. The port and airport at Rangoon have been converted to PLA military operating bases. The Burmese government in exile in Thailand has requested U.S., Allied, and U.N. assistance to force the withdrawal of the PLA forces. A large People's Liberation Army Navy (PLAN) force supported by Russian surface and subsurface units positioned on a north-south axis in the Andaman S
ea has taken control of the northern approaches to the Strait of Malacca. Your mission is to engage the PLAN/Russian naval forces in the Andaman Sea blockading the Strait of Malacca, and conduct air and Tomahawk strikes against the PLAN naval and air forces/facilities at Rangoon. You will rendezvous enroute with a force of up to 2 British and 2 Australian surface combatants which may be part of your alliance during this operation.
missions.intel:
Intelligence Message: A U. S. Destroyer escorting two U. S. flagged merchants through the Strait has been attacked and damaged by SSMs launched by a PLAN frigate. Rangoon airport and port have been taken over by PLAN military forces and are attempting to 
block the strait to all U. S. forces. Russian forces may be cooperating with PLAN forces in the blockade of the strait. PLAN forces are also believed to be supported with several squadrons of Badger, Fencer, Flanker and Backfire strike aircraft. Significant submarine threat exists to shipping in and around the Strait.
missions.task: Tasking: Continue on your Easterly transit to engage PLAN and possible Russian forces in the Andaman Sea blockading U. S. and allied forces from entering the Strait of Malacca. You will rendezvous with a force of up to two British and two Australian surface combatants which may be part of your alliance during this operation. You must neutralize the blockading forces to allow a second CVBG enroute from the Western Pacific clear passage through the Strait enroute to the Sri Lanka area of operations. Clear a path with the aircraft carrier battle group. Good Hunting.

goals.failure: Too Bad you were unable to complete Region 2 Strait of Malacca. Better Luck next time Admiral.

missions.title: Taiwan Strait
missions.description:
Campaign Region 3: "Taiwan Strait." China has initiated a very intense media campaign to gain support for a forcible reunification with Taiwan. China is mobilizing a major PLAN force to take control of the Taiwan Strait and begin an assault on Taiwan. Y
our mission is to proceed toward Taiwan and assume an optimum tactical position from which to operate with Taiwan naval and air units to launch air, surface, and subsurface attacks against PLAN forces. .
missions.intel:
Intelligence Message: During recent joint Taiwanese and U. S. Naval exercises one U. S. destroyer and two Taiwanese frigates were sunk by a massive PLAN air and surface launched cruise missile strike. In addition, Taiwanese naval bases at Tsoying, Makung,
 and Keelung were damaged by air attacks and long range land-based ballistic missiles. PLAN forces continue to mobilize to take control of the Strait in preparation for an eventual assault on Taiwan. The PRC government is trying to save face and build a 
base of power after recent setbacks in Burma and Strait of Malacca.
missions.task:
Tasking Message: Proceed to a position to the southwest of Taiwan and together with allied Taiwanese naval forces thwart PLAN forces from closing the Strait. You are also responsible for preventing any invasion forces from assaulting Taiwan. Your mission 
will be completed when PLAN forces withdraw or cease hostilities. You may receive tasking to eliminate designated land targets. Good Luck.

goals.failure: Better Luck next time completing this campaign mission of opening the Taiwan Strait.

missions.title: Kuril Island
missions.description: Campaign Region 4: "Kuril Islands." Japan has established a major sea bed mining operation 20 nmi west of the island of Kunashiri. Kunashiri is claimed by Japan, but occupied by the Russians.
missions.intel: Intelligence Message: Hostilities between Japanese Maritime Defense Force (JMDF) and Russian forces have broken out over economic rights concerning the Kuril Islands. Russian Naval forces have established a formidable blockading surface and submarine units also supported by several squadrons of long range strike aircraft based out of airfields.
missions.task: Mission Tasking: You are in tactical control of all U.S. forces which include USAF land-based aircraft and JMDF forces in the Kuril Island area of operations. You must defend your forces against attack and take control of as much territory as possible. Completion of this tasking is expected to establish stability in this region until a United Nations settlement can be negotiated. Good Luck.

goals.name: Kuril Islands
goals.success: The final campaign region has been stabilized due to your stellar efforts. You are truly one of the elite fleet Admirals of all history.
goals.failure: Try this campaign region again when you have a better command of the necessary tactics to succeed.

The U. S. surface combatant is directed to destroy known hostile land targets with their guns. The WASP Class LHD has Harrier fighters and Cobra gunship helicopters available to perform air protection, target destruction, and to identify unknown contacts. Y
our mission is complete once all designated land targets have been neutralized.

missions.title: Pacific Pirates
missions.description: Pirates in the South Pacific raid a cruise liner.
missions.intel: Pirates have been using fishing trawlers to make their escape to a local airport. Small turbo prop aircraft are then being used for the trip to Australia.
missions.task:
Pirates have raided a cruise ship sailing the South Pacific. American and Australian citizens have been robbed and murdered. This is the third act of piracy in the area this month. You are ordered to intercept the pirate's vessel and destroy it. The vessel was spotted in the vicinity of 01-50 S / 123-15 E on a northerly heading. If the pirates reach near shore, they will attempt to escape in an aircraft along with other fugitives already at the airport. The pirate aircraft should also be destroyed.

Numerous commercial fishing vessels and aircraft operate in the area. No civilian casualties can occur. Positively identify all targets prior to engagement.

missions.title: Macho Madness
missions.description: Brazil and Argentina fight over fishing rights.
missions.intel: Argentina claims a 200 mile wide economic zone off of their coast. Argentina has been harassing Brazilian commercial fishermen operating off the mouth of the Rio de la Plata. Known Argentine assets in the area are up to two Espora class frigates and embarked helos.
missions.task: By authority of the Admiral of the 5th Naval District, with headquarters at Rio Grande, you are tasked to seek out and destroy Argentina military units operating within 25 nautical miles of 36-30 S / 051-20 W. Assets under your command are the frigates Dodsworth and Bosisio, if available. You are authorized to destroy all Argentine frigates. Avoid casualties to civilian ships and aircraft.

missions.title: Iraqi Strike
missions.description: Conduct a Tomahawk cruise missile strike against a secret chemical weapons plant.
missions.intel: Expect long range air-to-surface cruise missile engagements at any time from Iraqi aircraft. The Iraqis have been known to use commercial air corridors to mask their movement.
missions.task: Upon receipt of weapons release orders, conduct pre-emptive Tomahawk strike mission against Iraqi target. Detailed Tasking Message and Targeting Package will be supplied in follow-on communications. Do not engage civilian aircraft.

goals.name: Destroy Chemical Plant
goals.success: The Chemical Plant has been destroyed.
goals.failure: Your failure has allowed a significant threat to Allied Forces to escalate.

missions.title: Wyoming Deploys
missions.description: Help an SSBN start her ballistic missile deterrence patrol.
missions.intel: The Russian submarines detected off the U.S. east coast in recent weeks are an Akula Class SSN and a Victor III Class SSN. Both boats are capable of carrying the 65 cm torpedo. Although the weapon has a reported range in excess of 25 nautical miles, operational firing ranges are expected to be limited by sensor performance and should be within 10 nautical miles.
missions.task:
The USS Wyoming (SSBN-742), under the command of Captain John Christmas, has departed the submarine base at Kings Bay, Georgia and is headed for deep water. Once the Wyoming reaches the 300 Fathom curve (1800 feet) she'll be able to run silent and deep and
 commence her ballistic missile deterrence patrol. In recent weeks, Russian submarines have been detected in the waters off the east coast of the United States, and may be in waiting to oppose the Wyoming's transit. P-3 aircraft from the Naval Air Station at Jacksonville, Florida have been assigned to patrol the area around the Wyoming. Additionally, the newly commissioned USS Connecticut (SSN-22), the second sub in the Seawolf Class, may be available for area clearance operations. Engage any detected R
ussian submarines and destroy them before they can attack the Wyoming.

goals.name: 300 Fathom Curve
goals.success: The Wyoming was able to reach deep, open waters and is on her way to her designated patrol area.
goals.failure: You failed in your mission to protect the Wyoming while she egressed to deep water.

goals.failure: The Victor II survived the mission.

goals.failure: The Akula survived the mission.

missions.title: Hair Trigger
missions.description: Defend yourself against long range cruise missile attacks and diesel submarine torpedoes. Your CVBG is deployed in the Eastern Mediterrenean Sea.
missions.intel: Various sources indicate that your carrier battle group is being targeted for elimination. Be alert for attacks.
missions.task: The Admiral has gone to lunch and you have taken command of a United States carrier battle group. Your orders are to keep the force out of danger. Intelligence reports Russian forces are determined to sink a United States aircraft carrier in the Mediterranean using long range bombers and a diesel submarine. Protect the CVBG for the next thirty minutes. Have a good watch, Captain.

goals.name: Hostile Air Eliminated

goals.failure: You did not eliminate all the Russian Backfire bombers during this mission.

missions.title: No-Fly Zone
missions.description: Conduct No-Fly Zone patrols in Northern Iraq.
missions.intel: The Iraqis have recently fired surface-to-air missiles at NATO fighters conducting No-Fly Zone patrols in Northern Iraq, and are suspected of having several SAM sites along the northern border of the No-Fly zone. Saddam is known for placing his military equipment near civilian buildings such as schools, hospitals, and religious training facilities.
missions.task: Conduct No-Fly Zone / SAM Trap patrols out of the NATO air base in Turkey. Engage and destroy any SAM Sites located in the operations area as defined by your intel message. Be on alert for hostile aircraft which may try and cross the 36th parallel. Avoid collateral damage to civilian sites.

goals.name: Clear Air Space
goals.success: Congratulations you have eliminated all hostile air and ground units. Saddam will think twice before trying to attack NATO forces again.
goals.failure: Your poor performance will certainly give Saddam reason to plan another major offensive. You should rethink your tactics and strategy for this mission.

missions.title: Deadly Transit
missions.description: Warships transit the Red Sea southern entrance.
missions.intel: The intentions of Russian forces remains a mystery, however, speculation is that they have orders to destroy any U. S. forces in this part of the world. An intelligence gathering vessel may attempt to shadow U. S. naval ships. A Russian guided missile cruiser is believed to be operating in this area.
missions.task:
You are in tactical control of a two ship Surface Action Group (SAG) transiting to or from the Red Sea. There are U. S. aircraft located at a land based airport available to provide air protection for transiting surface combatants. Your primary objective is
 to transit along an ordered track and destroy a hostile Russian cruiser, Russian intelligence gathering ship, Russian aircraft, and a hostile land based airport. Defend all U. S. forces during this mission.

No evidence of any undersea threat for this mission. The U. S. has countered with assigning your forces with the mission to eliminate all Russian forces in this operating area.
missions.task: The primary task is to destroy all Russian forces located at the entrance to the Red Sea. Two U. S. surface warships and U. S. land based aircraft are available to support this mission. Be prepared to defend your forces with all available assets.

goals.name: Strike Back Mission

goals.failure: A strong offensive capability is critical to complete this mission.

missions.description: Withdraw from the Gulf.
missions.intel: Expect air-to-surface cruise missile engagement at any time. There have also been reports of Iranian Kilo class submarines in the area.
missions.task: Withdraw from the Persian Gulf. Be alert to hostile acts by elements of the Iranian military. Complete the mission by engaging and destroying all hostile Iranian platforms, or safely exiting the Gulf with the carrier afloat.

missions.title: Indian Ocean Transit
missions.description: Transit Indian Ocean. Engage hostile Indian naval and air units.
missions.intel: An Indian Carrier Battle Group is on patrol in the Indian Ocean. Aircraft with long range air-to-surface missiles have also been operating out of airbases in India.
missions.task:
You are authorized to engage hostile Indian units utilizing the full force of your battle group. Two 688(I) class submarines have been assigned to your control and will report when ready for tasking. To complete the mission, engage the Indian battle group 
and inflict at least 50% damage to each surface unit.

goals.failure: You have failed to inflict a minimum of 50% battle damage to at least one of the Indian surface combatants.

missions.title: Bugs and Drugs
missions.description:
CVBG STRIKE MISSION:

Conduct strike against chemical/biological munitions factory on the Kamchatka Peninsula.
missions.intel:
The munitions factory is located in the vicinity of 53-30N / 159-55E. All pilots have been briefed with photos of the factory and should visually ID the target prior to engagement. Possible SAM site in the area.

Consider all Russian units in the area as hostile. Civilian aircraft are also in the area and must not be engaged.
missions.task:
Conduct Strike Mission Against Biological/Chemical Munitions Factory located in the vicinity of Latitude 53-32 N Longitude 159-56 E.

Positively ID units as Russian prior to engaging. Do not engage civilian platforms.

missions.title: A Line in the Sand
missions.description: A two ship Surface Action Group (SAG) has been detached to demonstrate Freedom of Navigation in the Libyan Gulf of Sidra.
missions.intel:
Libya has recently reasserted their claim to all waters of the Gulf of Sidra, a claim condemmed universally by the international community. Libya has established a "Line of Death" at 32 degrees North latitude as the boundary of the Gulf of Sidra. Libya is
 expected to react in a hostile manner to any force crossing south of the "Line of Death" into the Gulf of Sidra.
missions.task:
Your mission is to conduct a Freedom of Navigation transit in the Gulf of Sidra. A two ship Surface Action Group (SAG) has been detached from your battle group to conduct a transit South of Latitude 32 degrees North into the Gulf of Sidra, following a track remaining outside of the recognized 12 mile international territorial limit. The rest of the battle group is to remain North of the "Line of Death", latitude 32 degrees North, and cover the SAG transit. Once intelligence concerning the location of the 
airport is known, your forces will be ordered to eliminate this obstacle.

goals.success: Congratulations you survived the Line of Death Operation.
goals.failure: Better Luck next time in completing your assigned mission.

goals.name: Navigation Safe

goals.failure: Better Luck next time completing your assigned mission.

missions.title: Strait and Narrow
missions.description: A U. S. Surface Action Group (SAG), consisting of a guided missile cruiser and two guided missile destroyers is transiting the Formosa Strait.
missions.intel: Recent Intelligence indicates that PLAN forces will attack. PLAN forces believe they can achieve sufficient superiority of forces to sink one or more U. S. ships. PLAN forces may be supported with land-based strike aircraft. The possibility of a diesel electric submarine is suspected and as of yet not confirmed.
missions.task: A three ship U. S. Surface Action Group (SAG) consisting of one Aegis guided missile cruiser, the formation leader, and two guided missile destroyers is transiting the Formosa Strait to rendezvous with an oiler. The Aircraft Carrier Battle Group (CVBG) is to provide aircraft to assist with suppressing PLAN ship, submarine, and air attacks. An additional task will be to destroy a PLAN airport when the target has been authorized for engagement.

goals.failure: China controls the Taiwan Strait. The Taiwan Strait is now blockaded and a PLAN amphibious assault on Taiwan appears to be imminent. You did not complete your mission.

missions.title: Running the Gauntlet
missions.description: Coordinated strike, surface, subsurface, and mine warfare operations in the Gulf of Oman.
missions.intel: The Iranians have placed coastal surface to surface missile batteries on the Musandam Peninsula. There are indications that there may be minefields within the approaches of the Strait of Hormuz. Iranian air, surface, and subsurface units may have orders to attack commercial and naval vessels.
missions.task:
Your mission is to transit to the Gulf of Oman and conduct coordinated strike, surface, subsurface, and mine warfare operations as necessary to open the Strait of Hormuz and force an Iranian withdrawal from the Musandam Peninsula. Protect minesweeping ships
 headed to the Strait of Hormuz with carrier-based aircraft. Clear out all Iranian naval forces from the Gulf of Oman and Strait of Hormuz. Destroy all land based Iranian targets. Good Luck.

missions.title: Plugging the Gap
missions.description: A U.S. CVBG conducts an opposed transit of the southern portion of the Greenland-Iceland-United Kingdom (GIUK) gap to enter the Norwegian Sea.
missions.intel: Expect determined opposition to your transit. North Fleet submarines are unlocated and are probably positioned to intercept. Surface and subsurface missile platforms will be positioned for coordinated attacks. Land-based air has been moved forward into Norwegian airfields. This puts the battle group within striking distance for Badgers and Backfires.
missions.task: Your mission is to transit through the southern portion of the GIUK gap and enter the Norwegian Sea. You must arrive in the vicinity of the Faeroe Islands to complete your mission. This is the first phase of a two phase operation. An amphibious assault force is two days behind you headed to Norway and your CVBG is clearing the way. Due to tensions in the Pacific the Russian Navy is attempting to prevent your carrier group from entering the Norwegian Sea.

missions.title: War on Drugs
missions.description: A small U. S. task group is positioned to stem the flow of drugs from a Colombian cartel.
missions.intel:
Intelligence agents that penetrated the cartel report that there is a corrupt faction within the Colombian Navy that is actually using naval vessels to smuggle drugs to Caribbean ports. These ports are only transhipment points; the ultimate destination for
 the drugs is the U. S. mainland. There are two Colombian bases on the Atlantic coast, Cartagena and Barranquilla. It is not known whether the drugs are leaving one or both of these bases.
missions.task:
Colombian drugs lords have allied with a faction within the Colombian Navy. Yesterday, a Coast Guard cutter was sunk by an unknown assailant while investigating a cargo ship believed to be carrying a shipment of drugs to the U.S mainland. Your SAG has been dispatched with all haste to investigate, and if possible, destroy whomever is responsible for the loss of our Coast Guard ship. Your ships are the only ones close enough to engage, a larger CVBG is being assembled. Be extremely careful to identify all
 potential tracks before engaging, we don't want to anger any other nations which may be operating within their own coastal waters.

missions.title: Liberating Liberia
missions.description: A NATO task group tries to prevent the takeover of the capitol city, Monrovia, while rescuing personnel from the embassies of several European countries.
missions.intel:
Rebel forces have gained strength and are in control of most of the country. Forces loyal to the government are concentrated in the area of Monrovia and only control a 15 mile radius around the city. Rebel forces have acquired an assortment of rotary wing
 aircraft and are very mobile. They are also reported to have installed surface-to-air missiles at their major bases, several of which ring the capital city. It will be necessary to provide protection for the evacuation aircraft.
missions.task:
1. When government forces are able to stabilize the situation and move the embassy staffs to the airport, located at 06-20N/010-46W, evacuate all embassy personnel by helicopter lift from the airport at Monrovia. NATO is not intervening in the conflict other than to protect foreign nationals. Engage rebel forces only as required to ensure the safety of those being evacuated. 

2. Use aircraft on Jeanne D'Arc (CVH97) for evacuation and aircraft on Boxer (LHD4) for providing cover.

3. Set up air plan to have protective aircraft in the air throughout the rescue operation.

missions.title: Red Sea Chokepoint
missions.description: Russian surface, subsurface, and air forces are located at a chokepoint off the coast of Yemen. You are in command of two U. S. guided missile cruisers.
missions.intel: Russia has decided to deny all U. S. forces from entering the Red Sea. They have dispatched surface, air, and subsurface forces in the Red Sea chokepoint. There is no evidence of mines in this area.
missions.task: Your primary task is to perform a safe transit into the Red Sea through the chokepoint with two U. S. surface combatants. U. S. land based aircraft are available to support this chokepoint transit. Be prepared to defend your forces with all resources at your disposal. Additional tasking to eliminate important designated land targets may occur.

missions.title: A Furor in the Fjord
missions.description: Breaking the Russian blockade of Vestfjord.
missions.intel: It is believed that the Russians are expecting an attempt by U.S. forces to penetrate the blockade in the vicinity of Vestfjord and are massing surface and air forces to defend the Norwegian coast. The Kuznetsov CVBG is a major part of the Russian blockade. Additional aircraft have been deployed to airports at Trondheim, Bodo, and Tromso.
missions.task:
1. Your battle group is to break the blockade of Vestfjord. Conduct strike warfare, air warfare, surface warfare, and undersea warfare operations as required. You must neutralize Russian forces in preparation for an amphibious invasion of Norway.

2. Develop a flight plan for CAP aircraft and deploy ships capable of anti-aircraft operations so that the carrier is protected against air and air-launched missile attacks.

3. Deploy ASW-capable aircraft and ships to screen the battle group against Russian submarine activity.

goals.name: Vestfjord Transit
goals.success: Congratulations on your success as a Naval Warrior. There will be a parade in Trondheim in your honor. Russian territorial expansion efforts have been stopped. The Amphibious Forces may now proceed with their mission ashore. Well done!
goals.failure: Russian Military Forces are confident they will hold control over Scandinavian Penisula with their victory over your CVBG. The Amphibious Assault is postponed until the Furor in the Fjord has been quelled.

missions.title: Nuestras Malvinas
missions.description: UK Forces attempt to break the Argentine naval blockade of the Falkland Islands (Malvinas) in order to clear the way for an Amphibious Group to land on the islands.
missions.intel: Underwater sensors have reported snorkeling diesel submarines operating in the vicinity of the Falkland Islands. COLOSSUS carrier battle group is believed to be operating in close proximity to the Falkland Islands. Recon reports heightened flight operations from Port Stanley airport located at Latitude 51-40S, Longitude 057-53W with at least two SAM sites.
missions.task:
1. Your United Kingdom Carrier Battle Group, consisting of HMS Ark Royal and HMS Invincible, is to break through the Argentine naval blockade around the Falkland Islands. For your information, Brazil has formed an alliance with Argentina.

2. Prepare air-
capable ships for flight ops. Develop an air plan to support reconnaissance and ASW needs.

3. Factor the protection of the amphibious group into your plans.

missions.title: Red Sea Ambush
missions.description: Two U. S. warships are transiting to or from the Red Sea. Good luck and protect your forces.
missions.intel:
Russia has successfully negotiated permission to operate fighter and attack aircraft from an airport in Yemen. The intentions of the Russian forces remains a mystery. Speculation is that there are orders to ambush any U. S. forces transiting to or from the
 Suez Canal from the Indian Ocean. A Russian Kilo Class submarine may be operating in the vicinity of the Red Sea chokepoint. An intelligence gathering vessel may attempt to shadow U. S. naval ships. A Russian guided missile cruiser is believed to be operating in this area.
missions.task:
You are in tactical control of a two ship Surface Action Group (SAG) transiting to or from the Red Sea. There are U. S. aircraft located at a land based airport to assist in protecting these units during their transit. Your primary objective is to transit
 along an ordered track for about twenty miles. You will be specifically ordered to perform a humanitarian rescue of a downed pilot during this mission. Defend U. S. forces from a potential ambush while accomplishing your transit.

missions.title: Baltic Sea Magic
missions.description: You are the Commander of French Naval Forces ordered to break through a Baltic Sea blockade.
missions.intel:
NATO has suspended Germany from the alliance, however, all NATO equipment within German borders has been siezed by Germany. Sensitive intelligence sources indicate a significant number of surface combatants and some diesel submarines may be involved in the 
blockade. You will be supported with intelligence updates during this mission.
missions.task: Neutralize all German Baltic Forces encountered and break through the blockade. Additional tasking messages will be sent after specific land based targets have been either located and or approved for elimination. Protect the Charles De Gaulle aircraft carrier from receiving any damage. One French SAG is to transit North of the island and the second French SAG is to transit to the South. Good Luck.

goals.name: Baltic Sea Magic
goals.success: Your French forces have stabilized the Baltic Sea region. The threat of another European theater war has been averted. Good job.
goals.failure:

again when you think you can succeed.

missions.title: South China Slugfest
missions.description: Battle Group Commander of South East Asian Australian Coalition (SEAAC) opposes Chinese invasion of Spratly Islands.
missions.intel:
1. Reconnaisance indicates a Chinese flotilla of indeterminate size is currently north of SEAAC forces on a heading bearing 176.6 degrees. 2 Fast Attack detachments have evaded surveillance and their current position is unknown. 

2. Intelligence operatives
 report the Chinese are using one of their Sovremenny class destroyers as the flotilla flagship. Extra communication gear was noted being loaded onto the Huangfen 7120 and the Hoku 2 which likely indicates that they may be serving as command and control nodes. Targeting these specific ships may very well cripple the invading fleet, forcing them to withdraw. 

3. Indications are that SEAAC forces are as yet undetected by the Chinese. All SEAAC forces have been granted weapons free status. 

4. Be advised
, the Chinese are using merchant and fishing vessels to screen their advance. Avoid collateral damage at all costs.
missions.task:
1. Protect Spratly Islands from Chinese invasion force. Use element of surprise to your tactical advantage. Consider use of emissions control (EMCON).

2. Check the Intel Board, CIC has updated the Force Composition of the Chinese fleet.

3. Make prudent
 use of early warning aircraft so as not to give away the position of the main body.

4. Deploy ASW-capable units to screen the main body.

5. Good Hunting.
